replicationPolicy: Fixed before running these segments. Same three noise recordings, not independent patients or clinical validation. Do not tune the gate after viewing replication results.
developmentPolicy: The PR19 windows and clean presets were inspected during development. Report performance as known-set regression, not holdout validation.
acceptance: All numerical outputs, candidate peaks and boundaries identical before/after. HR evidence may only move usable to review; no numerical correction, suppression or promotion. Describe coverage and residual usable errors, including warnings on accurate rates.
limitations: Same detector at two thresholds: sensitivity test, NOT independent detector agreement or a calibrated probability. Periodic artifacts can pass both branches. Low-amplitude real complexes can cause review. RR variability is never a quality feature. review retains the raw rate, and a separate model audit may subsequently remove it.
